the proposed method is a very fast MMC model that maintains the identity and flexibility of each SM and the MMC topology, while achieving the same accuracy and speed as the AVM models when simulating the MTdc grid.
the proposed model can be used to simulate a large MMC MTdc grid with high accuracy and high speed.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the MMC can be modeled in a way that retains the identity of each SM, and yet can be simulated very fast, with the speed being comparable to the AVM.
a fast MMC model that maintains the identity and switching behavior of each SM, can be achieved with only a few simplifications.

a fast MMC model can be obtained by representing the MMC with an idealized circuit model and a companion model using an implicit time domain method, and the speed can be further increased by using a sorting algorithm for NLC based voltage balancing.
